notes: The list as posted has 58 cards; the strategy opens: 'For some reason their are only 58 cards in here Add in Orrimarko and another fallen portal.' Orrimaarko and a second Fallen Portal are added, for 60.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room ('Throne room'; the Light Throne Room deck, not Death Star II), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection and Staging Areas, plus one matchup Effect listed there: Your Insight Serves You Well ('vs HD'), Aim High ('vs ties and scum'), Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice ('against BHBM') or Ounee Ta ('vs rops'). All four are counted as cards in the 60. No Objective; the Throne Room is set as the starting location and no single starting Effect is set.
